verdict.rationale: Zep advertises deployment flexibility ('Cloud' vs 'Your VPC') which implies some control over where data resides, but there is no explicit documentation of selectable regions, data residency guarantees, or compliance certifications tied to geography. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI or API, documented list of supported regions, compliance/data-residency certifications (e.g., GDPR/EU hosting specifics).
